products.name: Recraft
products.note: Vector image generation; brand consistency; commercial design; UK-hosted

profile_text.body:
Recraft describes itself as a text-to-image model and design platform aimed at designers, creatives, sellers, and teams. Its site positions the product as a tool for photorealism, vector generation, custom styles, and mockups, and states that users can generate and edit images, vectors, and mockups using both Recraft's own models and other frontier models. The platform also offers a custom style feature that converts a user's existing images into a reusable, editable style.

The held facts record Recraft as a single product in the Image and Graphic Design category, noted for vector image generation, brand consistency, commercial design use, and UK hosting. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
